title: mzPeak L2 transform record
description: Governs mzpeak_index.json.metadata.transform. Written into FileIndex.metadata["transform"] by the converter when a lossy (numpress-linear) m/z transform was applied. Omitted entirely for lossless (--no-numpress / L1-clean) archives. The transform CURIE (e.g. MS:1002312 for numpress-linear) is the SAME CURIE stamped into the per-column array-index transform field by the vendored writer — single source, no drift (T-28-01). Tolerances are sourced from ToleranceContract::L2 (spec v0.3 §8). Three-places rule: src/schema/transform.rs + docs/mzpeak-imaging-spec-suggestions.md + this file.

transform.description: PSI-MS CURIE identifying the applied transform, e.g. "MS:1002312" (numpress linear prediction m/z compression). Must match the array-index transform field stamped by the vendored writer.

axis.description: Data axis the transform applies to. "m/z" for numpress-linear (intensity stays lossless).

conformance_level.description: Conformance level declared by this transform record. "L2" for any lossy-but-bounded transform.

mz_rel_err.description: m/z maximum relative error bound (spec v0.3 §8 L2 = 1e-7, ≈0.1 ppm).

intensity_rel_err.description: Intensity maximum relative error bound (spec v0.3 §8 L2 = 1e-3, 0.1%).

data_processing_ref.description: Id of the data_processing step that produced this transform (references the mzPeak data_processings facet).
